keyFindings: Historical completed units must remain separate from visited_units because visited_units records only completions produced by the active loop.
A typed immutable completion-continuity contract must be bound into the execution policy, outer-loop state, execution-intent binding, loop identity, and fresh-resume digest.
The cursor must equal the historical completed-prefix length plus active-loop visited_units length.
The repair necessarily includes execution_contracts.py and versioned schemas, not only the two originally identified reducer files.
Finite-frontier session budget must count remaining units rather than the original full frontier.
